label: The owner's retorsion: if there are no epistemic reasons, then no one has an epistemic reason to…
paraphrase: The owner's retorsion (#1007): if there are no epistemic reasons, then no one has an epistemic reason to believe that there are none. The encoded conclusion is the absence of an epistemic reason for that content. A conclusion about warranted belief would require a separate bridge from warrant to the possession of a reason.
